fields.name: input_res1
fields.label: High-resolution tiles
fields.help: Optional finer tiles from the same tiling run. Leave empty to skip prediction transfer and filter the segmented tiles at their existing resolution.

fields.name: segmented_resolution_cm
fields.label: Segmented input voxel size (cm)
fields.help: Voxel size used to prepare the segmented tiles. With high-resolution targets, the transfer radius is calculated automatically: 10 cm gives 17.32 cm. Without targets, this sets the radius for optional remapping to originals.

fields.name: mode
fields.label: Resolution of supplied predictions
fields.help: Controls matching distance, not output density. Choose the current resolution of the prediction files above. Original resolution means predictions retain original points and are matched within coordinate precision.

fields.name: original_collections
fields.title: Original collection
fields.help: Add one collection per version of the same originals, for example SAT predictions first and ForestMamba predictions second. Matching filenames and point order are required; shared attributes must agree.
